results.title: Maria Bäcke, Ph.D.
results.content: I am the PI for the project Goda exempel för skolnärvaro (Good examples for school attendance), financed by ULF for the years 2025-2026, where researchers from Jönköping University (Lilly Augustine and Elisabet Sandblom), Sylvi Vigmo (University of Gothenburg) and Therése Haglind (Jönköping municipality) collaborate with school leaders and staff in Jönköping. The above-mentioned researchers also work with a group of upper secondary students in the Superpowered Narratives project, which centers on students' storytelling and unacknowledged skills. The REaD-IT project (2022 - current) focuses on the reading strategies of students at upper secondary level and highlights the invisible competencies (primarily digital and language ones) as paths towards active citizenship. An upcoming article "Students’ Reading Strategies at Upper Secondary Level for Equity and Diversity" derives from the same research material will be published in the volume Diversity and Equity in Education, for which I'm one of the editors (together with Andreas Gegenfurtner, Christine Rubie-Davies, Dimitrios Papadopoulos and Özün Keskin-Senkal).
